- `pattern_fit`: A+B — 6-file fix across engine, main wiring and two handlers, plus two validator-free routes (measurement WHERE splice, SQLite-backed continuous queries).
- Strongest lever: the tempting wrong fix is extending the `read_parquet`/`arc_partition_agg` regex, which leaves the rest of the I/O family and the unvalidated routes open while the legitimate import/DELETE-staging/profile paths make an over-broad lockdown look unsafe.
- Biggest red flag: no O12 flag fires; the residual risk is recall — the public release note states the exact DuckDB lockdown recipe (repo size and build could not be measured without a shell).
